answer: Make newcomers enter through a sponsor who locks part of their own balance in a vault as a bond. If peers later prove the newcomer is a clone, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses standing too. Vouching for one real agent is cheap; vouching for fifty fakes means risking fifty bonds, so farms run out of willing sponsors long before reaching any zenith of influence. Trust gets written slowly, line by line, like a sonnet, not mass-printed.
